title: Manners in the Machine
why: The standard complaint prices politeness in watts and calls it waste. The measurement says the models inherited culture-specific manners, and the cost of dropping courtesy may land on the person, not the grid.
hook: Courtesy toward machines is supposed to be wasted effort. Researchers measured it: rude prompts degrade the answers, extra politeness does not keep helping, and the sweet spot shifts by language. Where did a machine get manners?
